records.scope: Flask application implementing the macyswineshop.com mirror: the age/state gate, the header with mega nav, the homepage section stack rendered from the seeded section table, collection listings with the upstream facet filters and sort menu, scored search, bottle and pack product pages with case contents and Junip-style reviews, the cart with the 6+ bottle free-shipping and 3-bottle-minimum rules, the multi-step checkout with state disclosures, guest order lookup, account management, the Wine Club page, the gift-card product, the Wine 101 blog, storefront pages, and the newsletter signup.

Deterministic build-time/boot-time seeder. All content rows come from the tracked source_data.json snapshot; every seed function early-returns on a populated DB and all dates are pinned relative to MIRROR_DATE (2026-09-22) so the SQLite seed is byte-reproducible on every build (PYTHONHASHSEED=0). Benchmark users use a frozen password digest.

Frozen snapshot of the live macyswineshop.com as served on 2026-09-22: 371 visible products with real titles, descriptions, tag attributes, per-variant pricing and the Drinks per-variant shippable-state matrix, 201 collections with real membership, 751 case-content bottle entries with per-bottle specs, 232 real Junip reviews with rating summaries, 87 Wine 101 articles with full content, 12 storefront pages, the homepage section map, and the per-state disclosure copy.
Per-file inventory (bytes, SHA-256, upstream source URL) for every managed image under static/images/; enforced by the image build's check_asset_inventory.py gate.
Real product images served by the Shopify CDN at the width=800 policy, in upstream gallery order.
Real case-content bottle thumbnails served by the Shopify CDN at the width=300 policy the live case selectors use.
Real homepage imagery served by the Shopify CDN: the two hero slides, the five category-tile bottle shots, the wine-club box photo, the three premium-wine tiles, and the Martha Stewart banner.
Real article hero images for the Wine 101 blog, served by the Shopify CDN.
The favicon, the four benefit-strip SVG icons, and the award-medal graphic referenced by the live theme.

Design system adapted from the live macys-wine-amplify-theme: Helvetica Neue typography, bright-red #E11A2B / wine-red #CC0000 accents, #FBFBFB surfaces, and the upstream card/grid/checkout/account/blog layouts.

Interaction layer implementing the upstream behaviors: the age/state gate, hero rotation, featured tabs, pack size selection with case contents, the Quick View modal, cart AJAX, quantity steppers, and notifications.

Jinja templates reproducing the captured upstream layout: base header/nav/footer with the age gate and Quick View modal, the homepage section stack, collection pages with the facet sidebar and sort control, bottle and pack product pages, search results, cart and checkout steps, account surfaces, the Wine Club page, the blog, static pages, and 404/500 handlers.

30 contributor-schema benchmark tasks (web_name, id, ques, web, upstream_url) covering search/filter/sort, product facts, case contents, cart/checkout, orders/account, compliance, Wine Club, blog research, gift cards, and error states.

Pytest suite: tasks.jsonl contract (five basic keys only, no ground truth leaks, sequential ids, port 40089 URLs), route/behavior robustness against a scratch DB (age gate, state compliance, cart minimum, auth, CSRF guard, search, pages), and seed determinism (byte-reproducible seed, image-reference integrity, benchmark users/history).

Resumable capture pipeline that produced source_data.json and the image manifest: catalog scrape (Shopify JSON endpoints + Drinks compliance), PDP scrape/parse (specs, awards, case contents), Junip review fetch, blog/page capture, homepage parse, collection-card sweep, the source consolidation, and the image downloader.

Raw upstream captures (gitignored, never shipped): rendered PDP/collection/page HTML, Junip payloads, disclosure copy, design screenshots of the live site, and the image download manifest that feeds asset_inventory.json.
